categories.title: Morphogenesis
categories.blurb: Reaction-diffusion, growth and cellular automata fields. Number keys switch presets, R reseeds, P pauses.

categories.title: Basics
categories.blurb: Pure computation. No graphics, no host services: the program runs and prints into the page.

categories.title: Language and compilers
categories.blurb: Generics, traits, enums, effect rows, and Flow tools written in Flow. Output goes to the page.

categories.title: Numerics and dynamics
categories.blurb: Solvers, optimisers, linear algebra and control theory. The ones that reach a native BLAS do not link here.

categories.title: Learning
categories.blurb: Small models and agents. The Metal and tape-runtime variants need host services that are not linked here.

categories.title: Systems and data
categories.blurb: Allocators, hash tables, hashing, parsers, file formats. Anything asking the OS about itself stops at the link step.
